title: The Price of Failure Risk: Clipped Barrier Policy Gradients with Convex Regularization
abstract: arXiv:2411.19193v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Many operations run on a budget that must rarely run out, such as a wear allowance. A wrapper keeps the remaining budget in the state, subtracts a barrier that grows as the budget shrinks and clips the combined reward from below at -m, and a standard policy-gradient learner trains unchanged. The clip level m is a price of failure risk, since the trained value splits exactly into utility before failure, the cost of a margin and the price times the risk, so whatever policy training returns earns the most such utility net of that cost among policies with no greater risk, up to its optimization error. Its risk exceeds a comparison policy's by at most order 1/m when charged costs stay bounded, and value or validation data certify it. The main theoretical result is exponential convergence of the population training flow under any parameter regularizer convex along the motions of the network's units and strong enough against the price

translated_title: 失败风险的代价：带凸正则化的截断势垒策略梯度
translated_abstract: 许多操作运行在必须极少耗尽的预算之上，例如磨损余量。一个包装器将剩余预算保留在状态中，减去一个随预算缩减而增长的势垒，并将组合奖励从下方截断于 -m，随后标准的策略梯度学习器无需改动即可正常训练。截断水平 m 是失败风险的“价格”，因为训练得到的价值恰好分解为失败前的效用、余量的成本以及价格乘以风险之和，因此在其优化误差范围内，策略训练返回的策略是在所有风险不更高的策略中，扣除该成本后获得最多此类效用的策略。当被计入的成本保持有界时，其风险超过对比策略的幅度至多为 1/m 的量级，且可由价值函数或验证数据加以认证。主要理论结果是：在任何沿网络单元运动为凸且对价格足够强的参数正则化下，总体训练流具有指数收敛性。
tldr: 提出截断势垒策略梯度框架，将截断水平 m 解释为失败风险的“价格”，证明训练价值可精确分解为失败前效用、余量成本与价格×风险三部分，并在凸正则化下实现了总体训练流的指数收敛。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces clipped barrier policy gradients that interpret the clip level m as a "price of failure risk," proves the trained value decomposes exactly into pre-failure utility, margin cost, and price times risk, and establishes exponential convergence of the population training flow under convex regularization.
